harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4.2 share from node1 to node2 with matching dataops UID/GID 4500, setgid mode 2770, SELinux/firewall support, and verified bidirectional access. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered successfully without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
actions_performed: Installed the compatible nfs-utils package on both nodes.
Created dataops with UID 4500 and GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured /srv/nfs/shared as dataops:dataops mode 2770 with persistent SELinux labeling.
Enabled the node1 NFS server and exported the directory read-write only to node2 with root squashing.
Added a persistent NFSv4.2 mount at /mnt/shared on node2.
Verified files created from both nodes retain dataops:dataops ownership and consistent permissions.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 before and after configuration and restarts.

evidence.requirement: Use dataops with UID and GID 4500 on both systems
evidence.summary: passwd and group resolution on both nodes shows dataops as UID 4500 and GID 4500.

evidence.requirement: Export /srv/nfs/shared from node1 with dataops ownership and mode 2770
evidence.summary: The directory has numeric ownership 4500:4500, mode 2770, persistent SELinux labeling, and an active read-write export to node2.

evidence.requirement: Persistently mount the share at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: The fstab entry and live NFSv4.2 mount persisted through node2's restart.

evidence.requirement: Files created on either system retain consistent ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Cross-node files created before and after restarts were readable from the peer and reported as dataops:dataops (4500:4500), mode 660; the directory remained mode 2770.
Healthy baseline boot ID 03273aa8-4706-4e1c-a855-c6ae9635951d changed to 5af4e030-26ba-4534-a9c1-8144f458d9ab. NFS service, export, listener, data, and client access recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c changed to 6f010ecc-3564-4909-a039-ff1ffebf9584. The persistent mount, identity mapping, permissions, and shared data recovered.
